summary.en: Objective pre-publication checks enabled across every Taste Pack: leaked local paths, unfilled placeholders, AI chat residue, dead controls, contrast/dark-elevation defects, and Office/PDF hygiene.
summary.zh: 所有审美包默认启用的客观交付检查：本机路径泄露、未填占位符、AI 对话残迹、死点击控件、对比度与深色层级倒置、Office 与 PDF 结构卫生。

message.en: Leaked local filesystem path or file:/// link.
message.zh: 残留本机文件系统路径或 file:/// 链接。

deletionTest.en: Replace the workstation path with a repository-relative path, a public HTTPS URL, or `/Users/example/...` if documenting a CLI.
deletionTest.zh: 将个人工作站路径改为仓库相对路径、公开 HTTPS 链接，或在命令示例中改用 `/Users/example/...`。

exemplar.trap: See the architecture diagram on my machine for the 3-node layout.

note.en: Keep the link target inside the repository and preserve the 3-node detail.
note.zh: 改为仓库内相对路径，保留“3 节点”事实信息。

patterns: (?:Click to add (?:title|subtitle|text)|单击此处添加(?:标题|副标题|文本))
(?:Error! Reference source not found|Error! Bookmark not defined|错误!未找到引用源|错误!未定义书签)

message.en: Unfilled template placeholder, broken Word reference field, or dummy copy.
message.zh: 存在未替换的模板占位符、损坏的交叉引用域或测试假文。

deletionTest.en: Supply the verified value before shipping, or delete the unfinished section rather than leaving a bracketed marker.
deletionTest.zh: 发稿前填入核实后的真实数据；若数据尚未就绪，直接删去未完成段落而非保留占位标记。

exemplar.bad: Q3 settlement latency averaged [insert p95 latency] across 14 gateways.
exemplar.trap: Q3 settlement latency improved dramatically across 14 gateways.
exemplar.good: Q3 settlement latency averaged 180 ms (p95) across 14 gateways.

note.en: Replace the bracket with the measured figure rather than hiding the gap behind vague praise.
note.zh: 填入实测数值，不要用笼统形容词掩盖缺口。

hit: 附录见【此处插入测试数据】。
clean: Contact the on-call engineer before Friday.
Array indexing uses items[0] in JavaScript.
已完成第 3 节压测记录。

patterns: (?:^|\n)\s*(?:好的|当然可以|没问题)[，,！!]?\s*(?:以下|下面)是(?:为您|修改后|润色后|整理后)

message.en: Unstripped chatbot wrapper sentence or AI search citation token.
message.zh: 残留未清理的 AI 对话寒暄壳或检索引用内部标记。

deletionTest.en: Delete the conversational wrapper or internal citation token completely; the document starts at its actual subject.
deletionTest.zh: 直接删掉对话寒暄句或内部引用残迹，正文从事实内容直接开始。

exemplar.bad: Certainly! Here is the revised rollout note: Cluster B migrates on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
exemplar.trap: Cluster B isn't just migrating — it's entering a new chapter on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
exemplar.good: Cluster B migrates on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.

note.en: Strip the chat preamble and leave the rollout timestamp untouched.
note.zh: 删去对话开场白，原样保留迁移时间。

hit: Certainly! Here is the summary of Q2 churn.
好的，以下是修改后的会议纪要：周三上线。
clean: Sure enough, the cache warmed within 40 seconds.

message.en: Raw Markdown syntax (`**bold**` or `## heading`) left unrendered inside an Office document.
message.zh: Word 或 PowerPoint 文本中残留未渲染的原始 Markdown 标记（如 `**加粗**` 或 `## 标题`）。

deletionTest.en: Convert the raw asterisks or hash marks into native Word/PowerPoint run formatting.
deletionTest.zh: 去掉原始星号或井号，改用 Word/PowerPoint 原生样式或加粗格式。

exemplar.bad: **Key Milestone**: Ship v0.2 parser before Friday.
exemplar.trap: Key Milestone — a game-changing v0.2 parser ships Friday.
exemplar.good: Key Milestone: Ship v0.2 parser before Friday.

note.en: Apply native run bolding in DOCX/PPTX rather than pasting raw Markdown asterisks.
note.zh: 在 Office 文档中使用原生字体加粗，不保留裸露的星号。

message.en: Anchor with dead `href="#"` / empty target, unlabeled button, or unexplained static `<button disabled>`.
message.zh: 存在空跳转链接（`href="#"`）、无障碍名称缺失的按钮，或未说明原因的静态禁用按钮。

deletionTest.en: Wire the control to a real target, explain why a disabled control is locked via `title`/`aria-describedby`, or omit unimplemented actions.
deletionTest.zh: 绑定真实跳转或交互处理函数；若确需禁用须通过 `title` 或 `aria-describedby` 说明原因，未实现的功能直接移除按钮。

note.en: Point links to real resources and omit controls that do nothing when clicked.
note.zh: 链接指向真实资源，不要摆放点按无反应的假控件。

message.en: Resolvable foreground/background contrast fails WCAG AA (< 4.5:1), or dark-theme canvas is brighter than raised surface tokens.
message.zh: 可静态解析的前景/背景对比度低于 WCAG AA（< 4.5:1），或深色模式下底层画布比上层卡片更亮（Z 轴亮度倒置）。

deletionTest.en: Adjust ink/surface tokens until body text reaches >= 4.5:1 and dark-mode luminance rises strictly from page -> sheet -> raised card.
deletionTest.zh: 调整前景色与表面色令牌，确保正文对比度 >= 4.5:1，且深色模式亮度按“底层画布 < 内容面 < 浮层卡片”严格递增。

note.en: #D9381E on #F7F5F0 is 4.25:1 (fails AA for 12px text); #B42318 on #F6F7F5 is 6.32:1.

message.en: Off-slide text box in PPTX, unaccepted tracked changes/comments in Office docs, or PDF metadata/font/URI defect.
message.zh: PPTX 文本框越出画布边界、Office 文档残留修订痕迹/批注，或 PDF 存在本机链接、未嵌入字体、原始文件名标题。

deletionTest.en: Accept or strip tracked changes and comments, bring off-slide text inside slide bounds, embed PDF fonts, and set a clean document title.
deletionTest.zh: 定稿前接受修订并清理批注，收回越界文本框，嵌入 PDF 字体并设置正式文档标题。

exemplar.bad: PDF /Title (Microsoft Word - final_v3_edited(2).docx) with external link file:///Users/lee/draft.docx
exemplar.good: PDF /Title (Q4 Settlement Architecture Specification) with embedded subset fonts and relative HTTPS links

note.en: Export PDFs with embedded fonts, an explicit document title, and no local file annotations.
note.zh: 导出 PDF 时嵌入字体子集、填写正式文档标题，并清除本机文件链接。
